text: SymPy Calculate 为 DSH Web 提供数学工具和 agent preset。sympy_calculate 接收完整 Python 脚本，使用本地 SymPy checkout 运行并返回输出。每次调用使用新进程，设有 120 秒超时和输出上限。需要本机准备 SymPy checkout 与 Python 环境，可通过 SYMPY_ROOT、SYMPY_PYTHON 指定路径。

SymPy Calculate adds a math tool to DSH Web. sympy_calculate runs a complete Python script with a local SymPy checkout and returns output. Calls use a fresh process, a 120-second timeout, and an output cap. Requires local SymPy and Python; paths can be set with SYMPY_ROOT and SYMPY_PYTHON.

能不能在 DSH 任务里调用 SymPy 解积分？
给我一个地方运行完整的 SymPy Python 脚本并查看结果。

我需要把 Python 代码交给助手计算并读回文本结果。

Can I evaluate a complete Python script for symbolic math in DSH?
SymPy Calculate 的功能「运行 SymPy 脚本」：向 sympy_calculate 工具提交完整 Python 脚本，工具用本地配置的 Python 和 SymPy checkout 执行并返回输出；每次调用启动新的进程。
SymPy Calculate 的功能「配置本地环境」：通过 SYMPY_ROOT 指定 SymPy checkout，并可用 SYMPY_PYTHON 指定解释器；未配置时使用默认 checkout 路径及其中的 venv Python。
SymPy Calculate 的功能「限制单次运行时长与输出」：工具执行受 120 秒超时约束，并分别收集标准输出和错误输出，单路输出最多保留 2,000,000 个字符。
运行计算前需在本机准备 SymPy checkout 和 Python 环境；默认查找 ~/sympy-dev/sympy 下的 venv，也可设置 SYMPY_ROOT 与 SYMPY_PYTHON。

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · SymPy-Calculate：A third-party DeepSeek Harness agent preset based on `minimal`. It adds one
stateless tool, `sympy_calculate`, which runs a complete Python script in a
fresh process against a local SymPy checkout.

> **Security:** `sympy_calculate` executes arbitrary Python with the current
> user's permissions and inherited environment. It is not sandboxed. Enable
> it only in sessions whose model and permission policy you trust.
@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Highlights：- Each call is bounded by a 120-second timeout; stdout and stderr are each capped at 2,000,000 characters.

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Set up SymPy：The tool defaults to `~/sympy-dev/sympy` and its `venv`:

```sh
sudo apt install -y python3-venv
mkdir -p ~/sympy-dev
git clone https://github.com/sympy/sympy.git ~/sympy-dev/sympy
python3 -m venv ~/sympy-dev/sympy/venv

For a different checkout or interpreter, set `SYMPY_ROOT` / `SYMPY_PYTHON`
before starting DSH.

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Install：Among shipped profiles, install into `web` only. The `web` bundle provides
the `agent-preset-registry` service the preset needs. A custom profile can
use the preset if that profile provides the service as well.

The easiest way is from the Web UI: go to **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter
`@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate@1.0.6`, choose **Custom address** under
**Registry**, and enter `https://registry.npmjs.org/`. Then select **Install**.
No GitHub URL or SSH key is needed.

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Install：Alternatively, from the CLI, install
[`@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate)
from npm into the `web` profile. If `dsh` is already on your `PATH`, replace
the `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` prefix with `dsh`.

```sh
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add \
  @e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate@1.0.6
```

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Install：<details>
<summary>Alternative installs: GitHub tarball, GitHub shorthand, or a DeepSeek Harness source checkout</summary>

HTTPS tarball, if you prefer to install directly from GitHub:

```sh
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add \
  https://codeload.github.com/11350613/SymPy-Calculate/tar.gz/v1.0.6
```

Git shorthand, when GitHub SSH access is already configured:

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Install：```sh
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add \
  github:11350613/SymPy-Calculate#v1.0.6
```

From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout, use `pnpm dsh`:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add \
  @e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate@1.0.6
```

</details>

Start or restart the `web` profile. **SymPy Calculate** will then be
available as an agent preset for new tasks.

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Verify：Check the composed profile:

```sh
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 --profile web --dump-config \
  | grep "SymPy Calculate"
```

In the Web UI, confirm that **SymPy Calculate** appears as an agent preset
without a **Failed to load** badge.

@e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| `sympy_calculate: no Python interpreter under ...` | Run the SymPy setup above, or export `SYMPY_ROOT` / `SYMPY_PYTHON` before starting `dsh`. |
| Remove the plugin | `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web remove @e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate` |
| Removal fails with `ERR_PNPM_MISSING_TARBALL_INTEGRITY` | Run `cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm remove @e_11350613/dsh-sympy-calculate --config.trust-lockfile=true` (skips lockfile verification for this removal), then restart DSH. |
